diagnostics.ramp_ttt_scope: Local1s interval-start connector stock only; upstream outside-component backlog excluded

definitions.flow: 30-second total cell outflow=downstream spatial crossings+off departures+terminal departures, converted toveh/h
definitions.speed_mask: Observed cellN>=5; poor predictions with N<5 are not silently removed
definitions.ttt: Freeway component only,30-second state trapezoid; not total Omega objective including urban/ramp waits
definitions.onset: First sustained low-speed span inside this prediction window, not necessarily original network breakdown time
definitions.source_fit: Additional actual admission-flow RMSE/1000 squared; prevents fitting mainline by hiding admitted vehicles upstream.
